saints.name: St. Irenaeus of Lyons
saints.title: Bishop, Martyr, and Doctor of the Church
saints.shortBlurb: A disciple of the disciples of the Apostles, who defended the rule of faith against the Gnostics…
biography: Born about 130 in Asia Minor, Irenaeus in his youth heard St. Polycarp of Smyrna, himself a disciple of the Apostle John, so that he stood only two generations from the Lord. He became a priest and then Bishop of Lyons in Gaul, succeeding a bishop who had died in persecution.

His great work Against Heresies refuted the Gnostic sects of his day and set forth the apostolic tradition handed down in the Church, appealing to the succession of bishops and the witness of Rome. Honored as a martyr, he was named a Doctor of the Church — “Doctor of Unity” — by Pope Francis in 2022.
saints.knownFor: His defense of apostolic tradition against Gnosticism.

canonization.canonized: Venerated from antiquity; declared a Doctor of the Church in 2022
